snippet.title: SAMUKID Trailer
snippet.description:
Add SAMUKID to your steam wishlist!

SAMUKID is a Sokoban-inspired deck-building action roguelike. Build your skill deck based on the faces of dice, collect loot with lasting effects, and forge the ultimate samurai. Discover even more powerful combinations through the synergy of skills and loot.
